catalog.name: demo-lending
catalog.description: A fictional consumer-lending shop. Every name in this catalog is synthetic; it exists to show each element of the catalog-yaml/1 format once.

domains.name: 催收
domains.description: Work on overdue loans, including the waivers granted to settle them.

domains.name: 客户与账户
domains.description: Who the shop lends to and the accounts they sign in with.

identifiers.name: 应用账户号
identifiers.notes: The same number can appear under two channels, so it is unique only per channel.

arises_when.condition: assigned when the customer passes identity verification

code_sets.name: 借据状态
code_sets.definition: Where a loan is in its life cycle.

concepts.name: 应用账户
concepts.definition: The sign-in account a customer holds in one channel.

attributes.name: 开户时间
attributes.definition: When the account was opened in its channel.

concepts.name: 借款人
concepts.definition: A customer while they hold at least one loan that is not settled.
concepts.condition: holds at least one loan whose status is not settled

attributes.name: 授信额度
attributes.definition: The most the borrower may owe at once.

concepts.name: 渠道
concepts.definition: An app or partner through which customers reach the shop.

attributes.name: 渠道名称
attributes.definition: The display name of the channel.

concepts.name: 客户
concepts.definition: A person the shop has registered, whether or not they ever borrow.

attributes.name: 性别
attributes.definition: The gender the customer declared at registration.

attributes.name: 认证状态
attributes.definition: Whether the customer has passed identity verification.

concepts.name: 放款
concepts.definition: The shop pays the principal of a loan out to the borrower.

attributes.name: 放款时间
attributes.definition: When the money left the shop.

concepts.name: 豁免
concepts.definition: The shop forgives part of what an overdue loan owes.

attributes.name: 豁免类型
attributes.definition: What part of the debt was forgiven.

concepts.name: 实名认证
concepts.definition: The customer proves who they are; afterwards they may borrow.

concepts.name: 分期借据
concepts.definition: A loan repaid in fixed monthly instalments.

attributes.name: 期数
attributes.definition: How many instalments the loan is split into.

concepts.name: 借据
concepts.definition: One amount lent to a borrower, repaid over one or more instalments.

attributes.name: 借据状态
attributes.definition: Where the loan is in its life cycle.

attributes.name: 逾期罚息
attributes.definition: Penalty interest accrued while the loan is overdue.
attributes.derivation: overdue principal x daily penalty rate x days overdue

concepts.name: 还款
concepts.definition: A customer pays money back against one or more loans.

relations.name: holds
relations.definition: An account exists only for the customer who opened it.

relations.name: renews
relations.definition: A renewal loan pays off the loan it extends; orig_loan_no names that loan.

constraints.expression: no two loans share a loan_no, whatever the channel
a customer holds at most one account in each channel
accrues only while loan_status is overdue
repaid_at is not earlier than the disbursed_at of every loan it pays
a settled loan never changes status again

representations.notes: Kept as JSON on purpose: any catalog file may be YAML or JSON.

scope: customers holding at least one loan that is not settled

bindings.derivation: sum of the daily penalty accruals up to dt

representations.notes: A renewal loan names the loan it renews in orig_loan_no; the renewed loan stays in the table as settled.

demo_dwd.dwd_party_customer_info_df.table_comment: Customer master, one row per customer
